newsitem.title: CHINA: Goodwill halts Singapore spinoff plan.
newsitem.headline: Goodwill halts Singapore spinoff plan.

text.p: Goodwill Investment (Holdings) Ltd announced on Tuesday a withdrawal of a proposed separate listing for its packaging subsidiary Winbox Holdings Ple Ltd on the Stock Exchange of Singapore Ltd (SES).

"The board of Winbox has elected to withdraw the proposal taking into account the conditions attached to the in-principle approval granted by the SES and the market conditions prevailing in Singapore," Goodwill said in a statement.
It gave no further details for the withdrawal.

Winbox considers that it may be in the best interests of the firm to maintain its base in Hong Kong to facilitate its future expansion in China and the development of its China packaging concept, the statement.
Goodwill said Winbox will in mid-1998 review the listing proposal to seek listing on the Hong Kong stock exchange.
Goodwill shares fell HK$0.15 or 4.4 percent to HK$3.25 in early afternoon trade.
